author: Allison

summary: Since the new dashboard experience became the default, we’ve heard from developers that it used too much space to show too little. Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default item count meant extra navigation just to see what needed attention.
takeaways: Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default item count meant extra navigation just to see what needed attention.
In addition, “Agent sessions” remained visible even if users didn’t have any agent sessions available.
Reduced padding across pull request, issue, and agent session lists so you can see more at a glance.
